name: Team Bulbasaur: Grass Control & Ground Pressure (Remix)
archetype: Leech Seed attrition, Electric coverage, and Ground-type weight-scaling wallbreaking.
gym_duel_rationale: Brock's Remix arena features Aron/Psyduck and Steelix/Mime Jr. Deploy Bulbasaur for Leech Seed attrition and Sleep Powder control, backed by Phanpy whose Ground typing directly exploits both opponents' shared Ground weakness.

roster.progression_notes: All 4 moves learned naturally by Lv. 9-12. Leech Seed bypasses Steelix's Filter ability and chips through Barrier.
Caught on Route 1. Intimidate and Baby-Doll Eyes soften physical hits from Brock, while Charge boosts electric power.
Caught on Route 22. Defense Curl doubles Rollout damage while boosting Defense to withstand physical Gyro Balls.

flex_bench.why_use: Caught on Route 1. Simple doubles stat changes from Defense Curl, creating a sturdy early tank.
Caught on Route 1 at night. Insomnia provides complete immunity to Aron/Psyduck's Yawn, while Confusion targets low special defenses.
